desc: Derive and document the validity condition for a fixed middle index: middle value frequency must be >= 3, or exactly 2 with all three non-middle values pairwise distinct.
Implement the aggregate middle-index sweep with prefix/suffix frequency dictionaries, total equal-pair counts, and the a+b >= 2 counting cases.
Implement the special a+b = 1 distinctness counting using D_L/D_R and per-value forbidden-pair corrections.
Verify against the provided examples and edge cases (n=5, all equal, all distinct, duplicates, negative values) and ensure modulo handling is correct.
